_real_world.hull_examples: Hulls 901 Hulunhu, 902 Chaganhu -- fast fleet-oiler/AOE dedicated to carrier group logistics
_real_world.primary_role: CSG fuel/missile/dry-cargo replenishment; sole hull class purpose-designed to keep pace with Fujian's carrier battle group speed profile
public_equipment: No combat weapon systems -- point-defense-only or unarmed per public reporting (USCC/Jane's, B-tier); this record carries no naval_weapon_system.mounts[] block
Underway replenishment rigs, both beams, for fuel/dry cargo/ordnance
2 x Z-8/Z-18 helicopter capacity (hangar + flight deck), vertical replenishment (VERTREP)
Navigation/surface-search radar only (no combat sensor suite reported at any tier)
_real_world.loadout_note: No weapons of any kind assigned to this packet for Type 901 -- purely a logistics platform. naval_weapon_system block omitted entirely, consistent with taoe6_supply.json template precedent (US replenishment ships also carry no combat mounts).

unit_conversions: full load displacement ~48,000 t (USCC 2020 report / Jane's 2019, both B-tier, within the commonly cited 45,000-48,000t range for this class)
length ~241 m (791 ft), beam ~30 m (98 ft) (Jane's/Wikipedia aggregation, B/C-tier)
max speed ~25 kt (12.86 m/s) (USCC/Jane's, B-tier, consistent with the class's design requirement to keep pace with a carrier group)
range ~12,000 nmi at economical speed (Wikipedia, C-tier, consistent with the class's long-endurance AOE role); no A-tier figure

naval_logistics and embarked_air_ops both follow the taoe6_supply.json logistics-ship schema variant (max_sorties_per_cycle/launch_interval_s/recovery_interval_s/turnaround_time_s), not the combat-escort embarked_air_ops variant used on Fujian/055/052D/054A/054B.
